description: A Web Components toolkit with fine-grained reactivity based on TC39 Signals.
rules: Pass the signal itself to DOM children and attributes; never call .get() in those positions (loses reactivity)
Inside computed() and effect() callbacks, you MUST call .get() to read signals — that's how dependency tracking works
A function used as a child is auto-wrapped as computed; a function used as a value (attribute, prop) is NOT — wrap with computed() explicitly
In defineElement.render(), use this.$xxx (signal) for DOM bindings; this.xxx is a raw snapshot
events values are transform functions (DOM Event -> detail), not type markers
All reactive state is TC39 Signal. Read with .get(), write with .set()
use untracked(fn) to read a signal without subscribing the surrounding effect/computed
